Fine.

We should choose succinct direct 2-3 sentence. "I don’t have personal wants or hidden motives. Leading "Nothing for myself" nice answers what do you want, but "Nothing" could mean no aspiration to assist. Wording "I don’t have personal desires or a hidden agenda" adequate.
